entries.e: France, officially the French Republic, is a country primarily located in Western Europe. Its capital, largest city and main cultural and economic centre is Paris.

entries.d: Capital and largest city of France
entries.e: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France.
The Tragedy of Hamlet, Prince of Denmark, often shortened to Hamlet, is a tragedy written by William Shakespeare sometime between 1599 and 1601.
William Shakespeare was an English playwright, poet and actor. He wrote plays, sonnets and narrative poems.
Water is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula H2O.
